Want that high-end designer look without the designer price tag? ✨ Sew this Minimalist Folded Tote with me!
No zippers, no complex hardware—just smart folds and simple seams. It’s the ultimate "Quiet Luxury" DIY project that’s perfect for beginners. Using eco-friendly materials, we're creating sustainable style from scratch. 🌿

Watch the FULL step-by-step tutorial on my channel! 🧵https://youtu.be/WGD_SsgCpBg

❤️ My Instagram https://instagram.com/tatiana_diy
•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•
✂️ Materials ✂️
🔹 Main Fabric: Heavyweight Canvas
🔹 Lining: 100% Cotton fabric
🔹 Stabilizer: Adhesive non-woven interfacing
🔹 Lightweight fusible non-woven interfacing (60 gsm).
🔹 Closure: 1 set of Magnetic snap fasteners
🔹 Hardware: Double cap rivets (for handles/decor)
🔹 Optional Pocket: 22 cm of #3 Nylon coil zipper
🔹 3/16" Rivets | 5mm Double Cap Rivets
🔹 TEP-2 Hand Press
